verified_fact: Prajapati Daksha held a grand yagna in Kankhal (modern Haridwar) and deliberately excluded Shiva. Sati, unable to bear her husband's humiliation, invoked internal yogic fire (Yogagni) and self-immolated. In deep mourning, Shiva carried her body across creation in the Rudra Tandava. voiceover_script: Kya aap jaante hain ki Bharat ke 51 Shakti Peeth kaise bane? Inke peeche chhupa hai Sanatan Dharma ka sabse dardnak aur pavitra prem aur tyag ka adhyay — Mata Sati aur Bhagwan Shiv ki katha. Puranon ke anusar, Prajapati Daksha ne Kankhal yaani aaj ke Haridwar mein ek vishal yagna ka aayojan kiya tha. Teeno lokon ke sabhi devta, rishi aur apsarayen wahan nimantrit the. Lekin Daksha ka ahankar itna bada tha ki unhone Mahadev ko jaan-boojhkar nahi bulaya. Unka manna tha ki shamshan mein rehne wale, bhasm ramane wale Shiv unke yagna ke yogya nahi hain. Mata Sati, jo Daksha ki hi putri aur Shiv ki ardhagini thi, bina nimantran apne pita ke ghar pahunchi. Unhe laga ki beti ko pita ke ghar aane ke liye kisi aamantran ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Lekin wahan pahunch kar Daksha ne samast devtao ke samne Mahadev ka ghor apmaan kiya. Mata Sati apne pati ka apmaan bardaasht nahi kar saki. Unhone bhari sabha mein kaha — 'Jis sharir mein is apmaan-karta ka ansh hai, main us sharir ko tyagti hoon.' Unhone dhyan laga kar apne bheetar ki yogagni ko jaagrit kiya aur yagna ki agni mein aatmadah kar liya. Jab ye samachar Kailash pahuncha, toh Mahadev ka krodh pralay ban gaya! Unhone apni jata se Veerbhadra aur Bhadrakali ko utpann kiya, jinhone Daksha ki yagnashala ko tahas-nahas kar diya aur Daksha ka ahankar mita diya. Lekin krodh ke baad shuru hua Mahadev ka asahy dard. Shiv Mata Sati ke jale hue pavitra sharir ko godi mein lekar teeno lokon mein ghoomne lage. Unka shok itna prachand tha ki unke kadmon se dharti kaanpne lagi aur srishti pralay ki kagar par aa gayi. Tab srishti ko bachane ke liye Bhagwan Vishnu ne apne Sudarshana Chakra se Mata Sati ke sharir ko 51 bhagon mein vibhajit kiya. Jahan-jahan Mata ke ang aur aabhooshan gire, wahan-wahan pavitra Shakti Peeth sthapit hue — jaise Kamakhya, Hinglaj aur Kalighat! Ye katha hume sikhati hai ki ahankar ka ant nishchit hai aur prem mein samarpan hi sachhi bhakti hai. Mata Sati aur Mahadev ke pavitra prem ke samman mein comment mein likhein Jai Mata Di aur Har Har Mahadev! Om Namah Shivaya!

description:
Sati Ka Yagna Mein Aatmadah — Shiv Ka Vilaap! 😢

🔱 Daksha yagna Sati self-immolation Shiva grief 51 Shakti Peethas

Prajapati Daksha held a grand yagna in Kankhal (modern Haridwar) and deliberately excluded Shiva. Sati, unable to bear her husband's humiliation, invoked internal yogic fire (Yogagni) and self-immolated. In deep mourning, Shiva carried her body across creation in the Rudra Tandava. Vishnu used his Sudarshana Chakra to divide her body into 51 sacred parts, creating the 51 Shakti Peethas across the subcontinent.

👉 51 Shakti Peethas mein se aapne kis pavitra dham ke darshan kiye hain?
